notes.title: Check out Prism Warriors DX during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Steam Next Fest is underway, and [i]Prism Warriors DX[/i], the sequel to [i]Prism Indigo DX[/i], now has a demo available for you to play![/p][p]The demo contains:[/p][list][*][p]All seven playable characters, with their unique Passive and Special abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 1 of the main campaign[/p][/*][*][p]One unlockable Prism Duel bonus battle[/p][/*][*][p]Four White Label difficulty modifiers, and five White Label difficulty modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]24 bespoke achievements[/p][/*][/list][p]I am only a solo developer, so getting feedback from others before the game releases is very important to me. I'm particularly interested in any bugs I may have overlooked, or any balancing issues (is one Prism Warrior too easy to play as? Is the Prism Duel too easy for a post-game bonus boss? Etc.).[/p][p]Please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514400/Prism_Warriors_DX/"]wishlist the game[/url] if you haven't already, let me know your thoughts about the demo, and I hope you'll buy the full game when it releases later this year![/p]

notes.title: Wishlist Prism Warriors DX on Steam!
notes.content:
[i]Prism Warriors DX[/i], the sequel to [i]Prism Indigo DX[/i], is now available to wishlist on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514400/Prism_Warriors_DX/

It's currently scheduled for a Q4 2025 release, and while there's still a lot of work to do, I'm confident I can get it ready in time.

I'll keep you all updated as development progresses, including a more concrete release date once the time approaches. In the meantime, please do wishlist it - the more wishlists it gets, the more visibility it gets!

notes.title: v1.7.1 Patch and Sequel Update
notes.content:
[i]Prism Indigo DX[/i] has been patched to v1.7.1. This fixes a dialogue mistake that, rather embarrassingly, was displayed in one of the screenshots on the store page without me noticing it until two days ago. (Mind you, at least nobody [i]else[/i] noticed!) I also made a few other small tweaks while I was at it, including replacing the game's favicon with a much clearer one.

If you're following me on any of my social media, you'll be aware that I'm working on a sequel, [i]Prism Warriors[/i]. Development was stalled for a while, but is now back in full swing. I'm aiming to launch its Steam page within the next few weeks, and the game itself should be out before the end of the year. I hope you'll look forward to it, as it promises to be much bigger and better than [i]Prism Indigo[/i].

Without further ado, here are the patch notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]V1.7.1 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Improved the look of Prism Amber’s shield
    [*]Updated a few achievement icons that still used the pre-1.2.0a bullet sprites
    [*]Updated the name of one of the Sound Test songs to match its name in the Soundtrack DLC
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed one of Prism Amber’s dialogue lines being incorrectly attributed to Prism Indigo
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Updated a screenshot on the store page that showed the dialogue mistake
    [*]Changed the favicon to Prism Indigo’s sprite for better readability
[/list]

notes.title: Free soundtrack DLC out now!
notes.content:
The [i]Prism Indigo[/i] soundtrack is now available as [b]free[/b] DLC! Totalling almost half an hour of pumping chiptune action, you can now listen to it anytime, anywhere, on any device!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930440/Prism_Indigo_DX_Soundtrack/

I'd like to say a massive thank you to everyone who's bought and reviewed [i]Prism indigo[/i] so far! I'm delighted (and relieved) at how well it's been received. If you haven't bought [i]Prism Indigo yet[/i], you still have time to take advantage of the 10% launch discount before it ends tomorrow!

notes.title: Prism Indigo DX is out now!
notes.content:
The day is finally here! Prism Indigo DX is out now on Steam, with a 10% discount until May 27th!

[previewyoutube=Hg0-a_VKbqA;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate, and to ensure the game is in the best state possible, the game has been updated to v1.7. Details of the update are listed at the bottom of the announcement.

For me, getting to release a game on Steam is the culmination of almost 20 years of game development. I'd like to thank everyone who has supported me on this journey - and if you're reading this, that includes you, too! I hope that this will be the first of many Steam releases to come.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]V1.7 Update Notes[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
    [*]"Exit Game" menu option (DX version only)
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Locked achievements are now shaded out
    [*]Icons for locked Compendium entries are now shaded out
    [*]Toned down some of the Stage 6 waves
    [*]Improved the Options menu interface
    [*]Adjusted the alignment of various menus
    [*]Bolded the titles on the game mode and difficulty menus
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed visual flicker when exiting the Sound Test menu
[/list]
